title: Corporate Catering Lunch Options in Dubai: What to Compare
body_html:
A good corporate lunch fits the working day. Compare providers on menu consistency, delivery windows, dietary information and the level of service your office needs, from individual meals to a staffed client lunch.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Distinguish team meals from client hospitality

Recurring team lunches need dependable portions, variety and a simple way to update numbers. A boardroom lunch may require quieter service, table presentation and a more structured menu. Give providers the actual use case so they quote the appropriate arrangement.

Check the building operation

Confirm loading access, security registration, lifts, food storage and where the delivery will be received. Decide who sets out the meals and clears the area. A delivery window should leave enough time before the meeting or staff break begins.

Make billing easy to review

Ask for a clear cost per service day, guest minimum, delivery charge and VAT treatment. myCHEF drop-off starts from AED 90 per person, with a minimum of 10 guests and AED 900 per order. Recurring arrangements and consolidated billing are confirmed in the agreement.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Explore the myCHEF service

If corporate lunch catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
